commission: D-001 condition 2: items D-002 excludes get explicit deferral dispositions, never silence. D-002: DR-108 is slice-conditional; no credential-requiring features in the preview.
ownerWhoMustRecord: Security + platform owners (file 08 DR-108). Coordinator may draft. D-000 does not make the coordinator those owners.
decision: Defer DR-108 wholly from the architecture preview. The preview has no stored-credential feature. Keychain and secure-file fallback are not designed as settled and are not shipped.
whatMayBeDesigned: Preview analyze/doctor that do not store credentials and do not require a keychain.
whatMustNotBePretendedSettled: Platform threat model for stored credentials
Redaction tests for stored secrets as a preview obligation
reentry: If a later slice adds a credential-requiring feature, DR-108 re-enters as OPEN for that slice and this deferral does not cover it.
condition2EffectIfOwnerRecorded: May count as the explicit preview deferral D-001/D-002 require for DR-108. Does not SATISFY the row. Does not affect a later credential-requiring slice.
reversibility: Total before owner recording. After owner recording, overturn also requires that owner's supersession.
